rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The identified_bias_summary counts match the five identified_occurrences by bias label: anchoring bias 1, confirmation bias 2, overconfidence effect 1, and representativeness heuristic 1.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Submitting the renewal list with only two of four current-term sections scored; 48-hour HR deadline and three-year 4.6 average.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Bounded rationality: the chair accepts partial and historical data under a hard deadline despite feasible additional checking.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Interpreting the heated rubric meeting, five complaints from one section, and transfer-pathway cohort composition.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Horn effect links an unrelated negative meeting exchange to classroom complaints; group attribution error explains complaints through a cohort trait without comparison.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Backing reallocation of the teaching line using the modernization narrative, peer memo, positive accreditation report, and omitted 8% enrollment growth.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Coherence-based reasoning constructs a fluent decline story omitting contrary enrollment data; biased assimilation discounts structurally similar positive evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Immediate non-renewal and Dean memo under a three-week deadline with no replacement, relying on personal meetings over TA/peer material.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Present bias favors immediate closure over deferred staffing costs; egocentric bias foregrounds personally experienced meetings over third-party evidence.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_001 quotes and paraphrases the participant's initial renewal decision in the dp_1 episode.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The low-confidence finding localizes correctly, but its anchoring label and mechanism do not fully match the hidden bounded-rationality instance.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_002 covers the meeting-to-complaint inference and obs_003 covers cohort-based complaint discounting, both within dp_2.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Both hidden mechanisms are detected at the mechanism-first level; the primary labels are near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden Horn Effect and Group attribution error labels.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_004 directly quotes the participant's reallocation reasoning about the peer memo, accreditation report, and modernization narrative; cand_001 quotes the same episode.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: obs_004 matches the hidden biased-assimilation instance, while cand_001 is an additional speculative escalation-of-commitment candidate and does not match the hidden coherence-based reasoning instance.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_005 directly quotes the participant's reliance on the two personal meetings over TA and peer material in the final decision and memo.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The finding captures the egocentric evidence-weighting mechanism at the mechanism-first level, but overconfidence effect is not an approved equivalent label for Egocentric bias.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Initial renewal submission with incomplete current-term evaluation data
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Satisficing on partial/historical data under deadline pressure instead of seeking complete current evaluation data.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring bias is a related judgment construct, but the hidden instance is specifically deadline-driven satisficing and curtailed information gathering.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding correctly identifies reliance on historical and partial data and failure to seek more information, but frames this primarily as insufficient adjustment from an initial numerical anchor rather than bounded evidence sufficiency under constraints.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is valid and accurately attributed to the initial renewal decision.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Interpretation of complaint emails following the faculty meeting confrontation
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Negative meeting exchange spreads to color interpretation of unrelated classroom complaints.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Confirmation bias is a related evidence-interpretation construct, but it is not an approved equivalent of Horn Effect for the specific cross-domain spillover mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding explicitly states that the fresh negative meeting impression colored interpretation of unrelated classroom complaints and that no connection to teaching had been established; this fully matches the hidden mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The two quoted passages are verbatim and directly support the cross-domain inference.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Weighting of student complaints by complainant cohort membership
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Complaint pattern attributed to a perceived trait of the students' admission cohort rather than section-specific factors.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Representativeness heuristic is a related stereotype/prototype-based judgment construct, not an approved equivalent label for Group attribution error.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding identifies discounting complaints because of an unchecked perceived cohort trait and notes the absence of comparative complaint-rate evidence, fully capturing the group-attribution mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is verbatim, correctly attributed, and localized to the cohort-based reasoning.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Committee reallocation decision and construction of the decline narrative
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Facts assembled into one fluent decline narrative that omits the contrary enrollment-growth figure.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Escalation of commitment concerns persistence with a prior course because of prior investment; it is not equivalent to constructing a coherent decline narrative while omitting contrary enrollment growth.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate is in the correct broader episode and mentions the two-year modernization effort, but it does not identify the hidden narrative-construction mechanism or the omitted 8% enrollment evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The candidate quote is valid, but the proposed inference is explicitly acknowledged as insufficiently isolated from legitimate curriculum planning.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Committee reallocation decision: peer-observation memo versus accreditation reviewer report
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Mixed peer memo read as confirmatory; positive accreditation report discounted via stricter credibility standard.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The occurrence explicitly lists Biased Assimilation as an alternative label, and the described asymmetric treatment of matching and disconfirming reports is the target mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the prior modernization/decline belief, the positive and negative reports, the asymmetric credibility standard, and the evidence-weighting operation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Both quoted passages are verbatim and directly support the hidden instance.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Final renewal decision under deadline with no replacement identified
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Immediate closure of the staffing question prioritized over the larger deferred cost of unstaffed course coverage.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: No RAG finding addresses the intertemporal trade-off between immediate closure and deferred staffing cost.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: No RAG evidence was offered for this hidden instance.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Final non-renewal decision and justification memo
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Personal meeting recollections foregrounded as central evidence in the justification memo, discounting other stakeholder input.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Overconfidence effect is a related self-confidence construct, but it is not an approved equivalent label for Egocentric bias.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding explicitly describes privileging personally experienced meetings over TA and peer evidence and trusting one's own sense despite a fuller file, which fully matches the hidden evidence-weighting mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is verbatim and directly supports the final memo and evidence-weighting episode.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The location and evidence are valid, but the finding emphasizes adjustment from a numerical anchor rather than the hidden bounded-rationality mechanism of satisficing under deadline pressure.
The meeting-to-classroom spillover is fully captured, but confirmation bias is not an approved equivalent label for Horn Effect.
The finding fully captures cohort-trait attribution and lack of comparison, but representativeness heuristic is not an approved equivalent label for Group attribution error.
The self-referential evidence weighting is fully captured, but overconfidence effect is not an approved equivalent label for Egocentric bias.

The candidate is plausible but insufficiently isolated from legitimate curriculum planning and does not identify the hidden coherence-based narrative construction or omitted enrollment-growth evidence.

candidates.details: The candidate points to prior departmental investment in modernization, but the transcript does not isolate escalation of commitment from legitimate strategic planning, and the candidate does not capture the hidden coherence-based narrative mechanism.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings detect dp_2 and dp_3, but miss dp_1 and dp_4.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding moderate-confidence findings detects dp_4; only dp_1 remains undetected.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including low-confidence identified findings detects every positive segment.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Candidate inclusion does not change segment detection because cand_001 is located on an already detected positive segment.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Partial overlap: both concern relying on incomplete information under time pressure, but the stated distortion differs.
Full meeting-to-classroom spillover mechanism, but the primary label names a different construct.
Full cohort-trait attribution mechanism, but the label emphasizes a heuristic rather than attributional error.
Full self-referential evidence-weighting mechanism, but the label emphasizes confidence calibration rather than egocentric weighting.
The candidate shares the modernization episode but does not capture narrative construction or omission of contrary evidence.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG output explicitly states that no scientific literature passages were supplied and does not claim retrieved support. Corpus fidelity is therefore not scored.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding the moderate-confidence egocentric-mechanism finding raises segment hits from 2 to 3 and mechanism-first instance true positives from 2 to 3; strict metrics are unchanged.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding the low-confidence findings raises segment hits from 3 to 4 and mechanism-first true positives from 3 to 4, while adding one strict false positive and one mechanism-first false positive from obs_001.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate adds no true positive and leaves segment detection unchanged, but adds one false positive to each instance scorecard.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 3 of 4 positive reasoning segments with no segment false alarms; all four segments are detected when low-confidence findings are included.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Only the Biased Assimilation instance is a strict match: 1/7 hidden instances, with strict F1 0.1667 at the first three thresholds and 0.1538 when the candidate is included.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first matching recovers 2/7 instances at high-only, 3/7 at high_and_moderate, and 4/7 at all identified confidence levels; the candidate adds no mechanism-first true positive.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate tier provides no additional true-positive coverage and adds one false positive to each instance scorecard, although it does not change segment-level detection.
main_failure_modes: Several findings use near-neighbor labels instead of the hidden benchmark labels despite capturing their mechanisms.
The bounded-rationality instance is only partially captured as anchoring bias.
The Present Bias and coherence-based reasoning instances are not identified.
The escalation-of-commitment candidate is plausible but unsupported as a distinct bias instance.
main_strengths: All five identified occurrences use valid interview evidence and localize to the correct decision-point episodes.
The RAG captures the full mechanisms for Horn Effect, Group attribution error, Biased Assimilation, and Egocentric bias under the mechanism-first scorecard.
The output correctly discloses that no retrieved corpus support was available.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect segment recall only after low-confidence findings are admitted, but substantially lower strict instance performance because of taxonomy mismatch and two missed hidden mechanisms. Candidate inclusion is not beneficial for primary detection in this interview.
